annotations.title: Create a workflow on a live n8n instance

description: Create a workflow on a live n8n instance (requires N8N_API_URL + N8N_API_KEY). Strips read-only fields (id, active, createdAt, ...) before posting. Workflows are created inactive — call workflow_activate afterward. Pairs with workflow_generate for end-to-end 'describe -> deploy'.

workflow.description: Workflow JSON to create (typically the output of workflow_generate). Either a parsed object or a JSON string.

name: workflow_create

id.description: The ID assigned by n8n to the new workflow.

name.description: The name of the newly created workflow.

workflow.description: Full n8n workflow JSON (name, nodes, connections, settings, ...).
